name: OpenRhen
description: Connects OpenClaw to the OpenRhen planner over remote MCP (OAuth), teaches the agent how to drive it, and reports agent time. Run stamp-url.mjs once to point it at your server.

oauth.scope: propose:agent-change propose:capture propose:catch-up propose:entity read:changes read:files read:plan read:proposals write:activity write:arrival write:cadence write:catch-up write:check-in write:deliverable write:disruption write:entity write:entity:commitment write:entity:current_availability write:entity:project write:entity:sleep_log_entry write:entity:span write:inbox write:plan-map write:recalculate write:recurrence write:routine write:session write:undo

agentTimeToken.description: An agent-time token (rhen agent-token create --name openclaw --scopes agent-time), as text or a SecretRef. Without it, agent time is not reported.

portalUrl.description: The OpenRhen portal's address (set by stamp-url.mjs).
